summary: Betty Jean Shefts worked in linguistics, Tibetology, and Indology. She studied under Franklin Edgerton (attested 1985) and Geshe Ngawang Nyima.
Bhadra Ratna Bajracharya is a Buddhist studies scholar who taught Surendra Man Bajracharya. He has served as Dean at Lumbini Buddhist University and Chairman of the Lotus Research Centre.

Bhadriraju Krishnamurti (1928–2012) was an Indologist and linguist who studied at the University of Pennsylvania (~1954–1957) and under Murray Barnson Emeneau. He held posts at Andhra University, UC Berkeley, Osmania University (1962–1986), and the University of Hyderabad (1986–1999).

Bhagavan Das (1869–1958) was an Indology and philosophy scholar who earned his M.A. at the University of Calcutta. He served as Honorary Secretary at Central Hindu College (~1899–1914) and headmaster at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith (~1921–1926).
Bhagirath Prasad Tripathi (born 1935) is an Indologist and linguist who served at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (attested 1976), where he was head of the Research Department (attested 1989).

Bhagwan Dash (1934–2015) was an Indologist who studied at the Institute of Teaching and Research in Ayurveda, Tribhuvan University, and the University of Delhi. He worked as a bibliographer and cataloguer at the Library of Congress.

Bhagwanlal Indraji (1839–1888) worked in Indology and history/archaeology, receiving an honorary doctorate from Leiden University (~1884). He was an honorary member of the Royal Asiatic Society (1877), a Fellow at the University of Mumbai (1882), and an Asiatic Society of Mumbai member.

Bhajagovinda Ghosh is a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. In 1994, he was attested as an Editorial Board Member for the Bulletin of Tibetology and Assistant Director at the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology.

Bharat Bhushan Vidyalankar (born 1931) is a scholar of linguistics and Indology. He studied at Gurukula Kangri Vishwavidyalaya, the University of Delhi, and Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University, later holding posts at Kendriya Hindi Sansthan and Sandhaan (1991).
Bhau Daji (1822–1874) was an Indologist and historian/archaeologist. He was educated at Elphinstone College and Grant Medical College and Sir Jamshedjee Jeejeebhoy Group of Hospitals (~1845–1851).
Bhesh Narayan Dahal works in Indology and history/archaeology. In 2018, he was attested at the National Archives of Nepal and served as an editorial board member of Documenta Nepalica.

Bhikkhu Anālayo (born 1962) specializes in Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at the University of Peradeniya and Habilitation at the University of Marburg, later holding positions at the University of Hamburg, Dharma Drum Buddhist College, and Sri Lanka International Buddhist Academy.

Bhikkhu Bodhi (born 1944) is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Brooklyn College and Claremont Graduate University. He served as Editor at the Buddhist Publication Society (1984–2002) and president of the Buddhist Association of the United States (2013).

Bhikkhu Pāsādika (born 1939) is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and Tibetology who studied at Magadh and Punjabi universities. His career includes posts at Punjabi University, the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the University of Marburg, and Frankfurt Buddhist Academy.
Bhikkhu U Dhammissara is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned his Master of Arts at Mahachulalongkornrajavidyalaya University under supervisor Sanu Mahatthanadull (attested 2017).

Bhikkhuni Dhammanandā is a scholar in Buddhist studies. Attested in 2007, she earned her PhD at the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies, supervised by Tilak Kariyawasam and Daya Edirisinghe.
Bhikkhunī Dhammadinnā is a scholar in Buddhist studies. She held positions at the Dharma Drum Buddhist College (attested 2012 as Assistant Researcher) and the Dharma Drum Institute of Liberal Arts.

Bhogilal Sandesara (1917–1995) was an Indology and linguistics scholar who studied under Rasiklal Chhotalal Parikh. He served as Head of the Gujarati Department at Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda (~1951–1975) and Director of the Oriental Institute, Vadodara (~1958–1975).

Bhuvan Chandel (born 1942) is a scholar of philosophy and Indology. She served as Director of the Indian Institute of Advanced Study (~1999–2004) and as a Professor at Panjab University (attested 2003).

Bhuwan Lal Joshi (1930–1977) was an Indology scholar who studied at Patna University. He held academic posts at the University of California, Berkeley (~1962–1967) and the University of California, Santa Cruz (~1967–1977).
